definitions: In a secluded location; in or to a place which is not frequently visited or not widely known.

entries.title: Off the Beaten Path (Dave Koz album)

blocks.text: Off the Beaten Path is the third studio album by saxophone player Dave Koz. It was released by Capitol Records on August 20, 1996. Koz himself provides vocals on "That's the Way I Feel About You."

entries.title: Off the Beaten Path (Justin Moore album)

blocks.text: Off the Beaten Path is the third studio album by American country music artist Justin Moore. It was released on September 17, 2013 via Valory Music Group. The album includes duets with Miranda Lambert and Charlie Daniels. A deluxe edition was also made available. The album has sold 364,000 copies in the US as of June 2016.
